title: Put On the New Self, Rules for Christian Households

questions.question: If then you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are ____, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:1 (ESV): "If then you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God."

questions.question: Set your ____ on things that are above, not on things that are on earth.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:2 (ESV): "Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth."

questions.question: For you have died, and your life is hidden with ____ in God.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:3 (ESV): "For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God."

questions.question: When Christ who is your life appears, then you also will appear with him in ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:4 (ESV): "When Christ who is your life appears, then you also will appear with him in glory."

questions.question: Put to death therefore what is earthly in you: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:5 (ESV): "Put to death therefore what is earthly in you: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry."

questions.question: You must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and ____ talk from your mouth.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:8 (ESV): "But now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and obscene talk from your mouth."

questions.question: Do not lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the ____ self with its practices
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:9 (ESV): "Do not lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old self with its practices"

questions.question: Here there is not Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, free; but Christ is ____, and in ____.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:11 (ESV): "Here there is not Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, free; but Christ is all, and in all."

questions.question: Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and ____,
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:12 (ESV): "Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience,"

questions.question: Bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has ____ you, so you also must forgive.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:13 (ESV): "bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has forgiven you, so you also must forgive."

questions.question: And above all these put on ____, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:14 (ESV): "And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony."

questions.question: Let the ____ of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom...
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:16 (ESV): "Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom, singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, with thankfulness in your hearts to God."

questions.question: And whatever you do, in word or ____, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:17 (ESV): "And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him."

questions.question: Children, obey your parents in ____, for this pleases the Lord.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:20 (ESV): "Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord."

questions.question: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the ____ and not for men,
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:23 (ESV): "Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,"

key_verse_text: If then you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God. Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth.
